crew.overview: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: To track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the world's fate at stake and dark forces from Ethan's past closing in, a deadly race around the globe begins. Confronted by a mysterious, all-powerful enemy, Ethan must consider that nothing can matter more than his mission—not even the lives of those he cares about most.

crew.overview: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.
crew.title: We Live in Time

details.biography: Filipe Pereira is the latest creative hire to join the expanding Twickenham Film Studios team. Filipe has joined the multi-award-winning sound department, bringing with him close to 10 years' experience in TV sound. Some of Filipe's most recent work highlights include Spitting Image, Les Misérables, Catastrophe, Absentia, The X Factor, and Benidorm, working with the likes of clients: Avalon, Britbox, ITV, Channel 4, E4, BBC Studios, BBC One, Amazon Prime, AXN, and Pulse Films.
details.name: Filipe Pereira
